name: Death Scythe
source:
Main character lives in a rural town and meets a death reaper girl one day. She predicts main character's soon death, but nothing actually happens. For this mistake she gets demoted and sent to live with the mortals and guard protagonist everywhere, even at school. This is the start of their communal life.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角生活在一座鄉村小鎮，某天遇見一名死神少女。她預言主角很快就會死亡，結果什麼事也沒發生。因為這個錯誤，她遭到降職，被派到凡間生活，並且要隨時隨地保護主角，就連在學校也不例外。兩人的共同生活由此開始。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
